About the Game

 

Meow meow meow—meow!!
Meow meow meow————meow!!

Cast:




【Lowest Combat Strength of the Divine Body Church】【Fragile】【Mission Guaranteed】

Fizz, a newly promoted "tea-serving assistant" turned official, is appointed as the protagonist of this story due to her exceptional professional skills~
Pitiful, reliable, and adorable~ She ventures deep into enemy territory to complete the mission assigned by the Lord~
Surely she won’t run into some ancient being performing a reincarnation ritual... How could such a thing happen?

【Black Cat in the Dark Night】、【What Bad Intentions Could It Have?】、【Pet Administrator】

Kat, who seemed to have studied medicine before joining the crew, later became an actor for unknown reasons~
She enjoys spending time with the small animals around the set, as it brings her peace of mind.
The most formidable opponent you’ll face in this story—if you encounter her... run for your life~

Background:

Hundreds of years ago, a calamity gave birth to man-eating monsters known as the "Forsaken." Under the leadership of the "Calamity King" Guy, they established the Forsaken Empire, where "Forsaken reign supreme, and humans are food."
Meanwhile, humanity, led by the "Holy Sword Knight"洛斯, fought back fiercely. United under the Divine Body Church he founded, they ultimately defeated the Forsaken Empire and established five kingdoms in the southern part of the Hel continent.
To the southeast of the five kingdoms lies the vast territory of the Gules Kingdom, south of which stretches an immense forest.
This is a forbidden zone for humans—any who step inside will lose their way;
This is a paradise for animals—all creatures that come here can find a home;
This place is known by the Church as—the Witch's Forest.
The ruler of this domain is Chaos-Born, the Tearless One, the Queen of Curses, the Sovereign of the Witch's Forest, the Scholar of Ancient Curses, the Master of Potions, the Lord of the Dark Night, one of the Seven Calamities—the Witch Kate~

Plot Introduction:

What awaits the young girl is a seemingly simple task... or is it?
Alone, she infiltrates the terrifying Witch's Forest to find a lost cat belonging to a foolish noble!
The weakest combatant in the entire forest is none other than the protagonist, Fizz.
Proceed with caution, step by step, befriend the "cats" in the forest, and rely on courage and wisdom to find that little cat with no bad intentions~ And then... make it back alive~

Stage Introduction:

【Hel Continent】

A continent situated in the ocean, serving as the main stage for this story~

【Witch's Forest】

Located south of the Gules Kingdom in the southern part of the five kingdoms, it is the domain of one of the Seven Calamities, the Witch Kate, where countless animal-like Forsaken gather.

Features of This Story:

【High-Quality Art】

An adorable & healing art style, exquisite character illustrations, and charming chibi-style characters~

【Thrilling Adventure】

Eerie and astonishing scenes, sudden unknown dangers that will make your heart race—an immersive experience of adventure~

Interact closely with a variety of feline friends~ What bad intentions could a little cat possibly have?~

剧务组成员：

【Staff】

制作组：圣剑提灯制作组

制作人：农夫卡卡萝

原案：农夫卡卡萝、丹哥、大义

剧本/演出：农夫卡卡萝、丹哥

文案：农夫卡卡萝

文案纠错/配置/演出辅助：农夫卡卡萝、丹哥、呆呆

场景原画：小Y

角色原画：农夫卡卡萝、小Y

CG原画：农夫卡卡萝、小Y

动画：农夫卡卡萝、小Y、大义

UI：小Y

PV/美宣：农夫卡卡萝、小Y、呆呆

关卡玩法策划：农夫卡卡萝、呆呆

地图编辑：呆呆、苏摩

data.short_description: To find the noble's cat, you've come to the calamity-filled Witch's Forest—eerie and trap-ridden. As Divine Knight Feyz, evade dangers, befriend companions, and interact with the forest's "little cats" to solve mysteries and complete your mission!
